programs.name: ax
programs.description: A minimal headless LLM coding-agent harness for scripts and Unix-style clients.

programs.name: boti
programs.description: Reads bot.toml, installs the declared binaries, wires the Botdir environment, runs the hooks and starts the consumer from the bot root.

programs.name: slaxi
programs.description: Connects the ax engine to Slack: listens for mentions, runs the bot and posts replies back.

programs.name: wax
programs.description: Fetches a web page as Markdown for ax and other LLM tools.

programs.name: slackx
programs.description: Uploads files to Slack for ax.

programs.name: browserx
programs.description: Read-only visible Chromium tool for ax.

programs.name: bashx
programs.description: Runs non-interactive shell commands for ax.

programs.name: fsx
programs.description: Reads, writes and edits files inside the workspace.

programs.name: attachx
programs.description: Copies workspace files into the bot's artifact directory so a transport can deliver them to the user.

programs.name: acpi
programs.description: Speaks Agent Client Protocol over stdio and runs ax as a subprocess per turn, so any ACP host can drive the engine.

programs.name: mcpx
programs.description: Connects MCP servers and exposes their tools in ax's describe/run convention.

programs.name: botdir
programs.description: The portable directory interface for bots. Not a binary: every other piece conforms to it.
